description: This is a Python source file for a tool that interacts with Intel ADSP hardware, providing firmware loading, device configuration, and logging functionalities. It includes classes and functions for memory mapping, hardware register access, firmware management, and IPC command handling.

classes.name: HDAStream
classes.description: Represents an HD Audio stream with methods for configuration, starting, stopping, and resetting the stream, including buffer setup and register manipulation.

classes.name: Regs
classes.description: Helper class for defining and accessing hardware registers via memory-mapped I/O.

methods.name: map_phys_mem
methods.description: Maps 2MB of hugepage memory and retrieves its physical address for DMA use.

methods.name: bar_map
methods.description: Maps PCI BAR resource into process address space.

methods.name: load_firmware
methods.description: Loads firmware into the device, configures hardware registers, and initiates firmware execution.

methods.name: fw_is_alive
methods.description: Checks if the firmware has entered the 'FW_ENTERED' state.

methods.name: wait_fw_entered
methods.description: Waits until firmware signals it has entered the operational state or times out.

methods.name: win_read
methods.description: Reads bytes from the winstream memory region.

methods.name: win_hdr
methods.description: Reads and unpacks the header of the winstream data.

methods.name: winstream_read
methods.description: Reads and decodes the next chunk of winstream log data.

methods.name: ipc_delay_done
methods.description: Asynchronous delay to signal IPC completion.

methods.name: ipc_command
methods.description: Handles IPC commands received from the DSP, including HDA stream control and memory operations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that initializes hardware, loads firmware, and processes log output and IPC commands.
